title: Nail Behavioral Interviews with STAR Stories

scenes.say: Ever wonder why some interview answers just click for hiring managers? What makes your story stick?

scenes.label: STAR
scenes.sub: Situation, Task, Action, Result. It's the backbone.
scenes.say: The STAR method—situation, task, action, result—is the backbone of every strong behavioral answer.
Walk through each step. Set the scene, explain your goal, show what you did, and highlight the outcome. Always say what you owned.
When asked about weaknesses, skip fake answers like 'I work too hard.' Share a real gap and what you’re doing to improve.

scenes.question: What habit costs strong people offers?
scenes.right: Not owning your part or skipping results makes you look weak. Always own your story.
scenes.say: A common trap? Blaming others or skipping your own impact. If you don’t own your story, you look weak.
